title: OpenVA Public Vendor Assurance Source References
description: OpenVA is a public-source-only metadata dataset for vendor-published assurance references. It records factual locator metadata about public vendor assurance materials such as trust centers, privacy pages, security pages, data processing addenda, subprocessor lists, status pages, public certification references, public KYC/AML statements, AI/data terms, and related source references. OpenVA is not a legal, compliance, procurement, audit, security, KYC, AML, sanctions, regulatory, or vendor-risk advice product. It does not approve, score, certify, monitor, or assess vendors.
notes: Public locator metadata only; not vendor approval, certification, scoring, monitoring, assessment, legal advice, compliance advice, procurement advice, security advice, audit advice, KYC advice, AML advice, sanctions advice, regulatory advice, or vendor-risk advice.
